notes:
v4.6.58 — Real-time data (incl. cloud) + one-switch Live for IBKR & Alpaca

📈 LIVE MARKET DATA — now that you hold the IBKR data subscription, the app requests REAL-TIME quotes (live share values + order pricing), on your computer AND on the 24/7 Oracle cloud bots. (Cloud uses your paper account, so enable Client Portal → Settings → Paper Trading → 'Share market data subscriptions with paper account'.) If a subscription isn't available, pricing safely falls back to delayed quotes and then a free public source.

🔀 IBKR — ONE SWITCH TO REAL MONEY
• Flip the Paper / Live toggle in the header to trade your real IBKR account. Live reuses the bot Client-IDs and % allocations you set up under paper.
• Live IBKR runs LOCALLY against your live TWS / IB Gateway (you approve IBKR Mobile 2FA on your phone). IBKR bots won't run on the Oracle cloud in Live mode — IBKR requires 2FA on every live login, which can't be approved head-less. Paper IBKR still runs 24/7 on the cloud.

🔀 ALPACA — SAME PAPER / LIVE SWITCH
• The Alpaca API-key section is now mode-aware: in Live mode it stores/uses your separate LIVE Alpaca keys (paper & live are different accounts with different keys). Enter them once; flipping the header toggle trades the live account.

How to go live: configure your live keys (IBKR: log into live TWS + enable API; Alpaca: paste live keys in Tools), then flip the header toggle. Test with a tiny order first.

Update via the in-app banner.
